decision: delayed corp/user/get-selfinfo by 5s through CDP Fetch interception, reloaded /#/contact/member, and sampled .arco-menu-item every 150ms
why: the report says the 成员管理 sidebar entry intermittently hides; the symptom must be observed on the real page, not guessed
result: menu rendered at 343ms without 成员管理; entry appeared at 5439ms when the query resolved

decision: SideBar.vue treated an unresolved selfInfo.type as denied
why: for role-gated routes the menu filter compared meta.roles against selfInfo?.type, so undefined was not in [255,1] and the entry was dropped until the async query resolved
result: the only route with meta.roles is the member route; every other entry rendered immediately

decision: keep role-gated routes while selfInfo.type is undefined; apply the roles check once the type is known
why: unknown permission is not denial; the route itself is not guarded, so the gate is cosmetic and defaults to visible elsewhere (vip disabledList)
result: repro PASS: menu rendered at 316ms with 成员管理

decision: reran the same probe on the fixed build after restoring the pre-fix file and re-applying the fix
why: the script must fail before and pass after, not only pass after
result: pre-fix FAIL (missing in 33 samples, first 343ms); post-fix PASS (present from 316ms)

decision: left direct-URL access for accounts outside meta.roles unchanged
why: the earlier QA run already flagged the menu/route role mismatch as a product decision, and this bug is the flicker
result: open product decision, not changed here

decision: made useWeilaFetch return data as T | undefined and removed the ComputedRef<T> assertion
why: the cast told the compiler data is always present, so roles.includes(selfInfo?.type) type-checked even though the runtime value could be undefined
result: old condition now fails with TS2345: 'number | undefined' is not assignable to 'number'

decision: the truthful type surfaced 7 unguarded accesses in AddDeviceModal, CreateMemberModal, EditDeviceModal, and EditCorpModal
why: all four read vip or corp data before the query resolves; optional chaining matches the old behavior once data is loaded
result: only the 5 pre-existing typecheck errors remain; runtime probe still passes
